- **L-4753, Uz. Haliye Almast İnönü Soylu:** I did not open her account.

  - **Compliance:** I escalated her case (ESC-65C399). Compliance says its queue is about 10 business days. In my note I flagged that her declared occupation (subsistence fishing and hunting) doesn't fit her stated source of funds ("salary").

  - **Customer:** I told her about the delay. She replied that she wants the account open before the end of the month. The Compliance queue makes that unlikely.

The branch will most likely miss the 43-account target. I wasn't willing to open a high-risk PEP account without the required checks to hit it. The handover note says to open her account once EDD is complete and Compliance clears it.
